using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using Mindweave.Application.Chat;
using Mindweave.Core.Chat;
using Mindweave.Infrastructure.Runtime;
using Mindweave.Infrastructure.Storage;
using Xunit;
namespace Mindweave.Tests;
public sealed class GenerateFormat3Golden(ITestOutputHelper output)
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Generate()
    {
        Assert.Equal(3, ReplyContextPlanner.FormatVersion);
        var destination = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("MINDWEAVE_GOLDEN_DESTINATION")!;
        using var dir = new TestDirectory(); var paths = AppPaths.ForTrack("codex-steady", dir.Path);
        object manifest;
        await using (var store = await SqliteWorkspaceStore.OpenAsync(paths))
        {
            var root = await store.CreateConversationAsync((await store.CreateAsync("synthetic format3 golden")).Id);
            for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) await BranchStorageTests.Answer(store, root.Id, "synthetic question " + i, new string((char)('a' + i), 2500));
            var source = (await store.ReadMessagesAsync(root.Id))[^1];
            var selection = BranchStorageTests.Selection(source) with { Quote = "e" };
            var producer = await store.CreateBranchAsync(root.Id, selection, Guid.NewGuid());
            var sibling = await store.CreateBranchAsync(root.Id, selection, Guid.NewGuid());
            var config = BranchStorageTests.Config(16000) with { MaxOutputTokens = 4096 };
            var left = await store.AcceptReplyAsync(producer.Id, "producer synthetic current", config);
            var right = await store.AcceptReplyAsync(sibling.Id, "sibling synthetic current", config);
            var chunks = left.ContextPlan!.Parts.OfType<SummaryContextPart>().Select(p => p.Chunk).ToArray();
            Assert.NotEmpty(chunks); Assert.All(chunks, chunk => Assert.Equal(4096, chunk.MaxOutputTokens));
            var summaries = new List<CompletedContextSummary>();
            var requests = new List<ChatRequest>();
            var attempts = new List<ContextCompressionAttempt>();
            foreach (var chunk in chunks)
            {
                requests.Add(ReplyContextPlanner.CreateSummaryRequest(root.Id, chunk, left.InputMessages, config));
                var attempt = await store.StartCompressionAsync(left.Task.Id, chunk.CacheKey);
                await store.WriteCompressionAsync(left.Task.Id, attempt.Id, 1,
                    ContextSummaryProtocol.Serialize(new ContextSummaryContent(summaries.Count == 0 ? new string('z', 3330) : "synthetic old facts", "", "", "", "")), GenerationStatus.Completed, "stop", actualModelId: "synthetic-model");
                summaries.Add((await store.LoadCompletedSummaryAsync(right.Task.Id, chunk.CacheKey))!);
                attempts.Add((await store.LoadCompressionAttemptAsync(attempt.Id))!);
            }
            var prepared = await store.PrepareReplyRequestAsync(right.Task.Id);
            await store.PrepareReplyRequestAsync(left.Task.Id);
            await store.WriteGenerationAsync(left.Task.Id, 1, "synthetic producer answer", GenerationStatus.Completed);
            await store.WriteGenerationAsync(right.Task.Id, 1, "synthetic sibling answer", GenerationStatus.Completed);
            manifest = new { Baseline = "bc4a46c87cb94f351ed6d813bb584d21ac38d64b", RootId = root.Id, ProducerId = producer.Id,
                SiblingId = sibling.Id, ProducerTaskId = left.Task.Id, TaskId = right.Task.Id, Configuration = config,
                Attempts = attempts, Originals = right.InputMessages, Chunks = chunks, Summaries = summaries, SummaryRequests = requests, Prepared = prepared,
                PreparedHash = ContextStorageTests.Sql(paths, "SELECT request_hash FROM prepared_reply_request WHERE task_id=$id", ("$id", right.Task.Id)) };
        }
        Directory.CreateDirectory(destination);
        File.Copy(paths.DatabasePath, Path.Combine(destination, "format3.db"), overwrite: true);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(destination, "manifest.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(manifest, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
        foreach (var name in new[] { "format3.db", "manifest.json" })
            output.WriteLine($"GOLDEN {name} SHA256={Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(Path.Combine(destination, name))))}");
        output.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(manifest));
    }
}
